title: SG-2.3 Switch content and manifest to the PNGs and remove the SVGs
summary: World content and manifest reference only generated PNG ids; all placeholder SVGs are deleted
description: Context: SG-2.1 (room grids) and SG-2.2 (boy sheet and portrait) are done, but game/frontend/src/art/sources.ts ART_SOURCES still omits the room grids. bedroom.yaml and manifest.json still reference 320x180 SVG ids, and BootScene and the generator already exist. Desired behaviour: the scene is laid out at 480x270 from PNG ids only, BootScene preloads them with no fallback texture, and every SVG under public/assets (bedroom.svg included) is gone. Expected result: no .svg path remains in manifest or content. Why: it finishes the art replacement in SG-2.
acceptance_criteria: Given the committed manifest and bedroom.yaml, when their asset refs are listed, then none ends in .svg and every ref resolves to a manifest id
Given the generated PNGs, when each is checked against the manifest, then its size equals the declared size and it uses only palette colours
Given BootScene preload, when it runs with the real manifest, then every scene asset loads and no fallback texture is resolved
Given the repository, when assets are listed, then no .svg file exists under game/public/assets or game/frontend/public/assets

in_scope: Sources for the remaining scene assets, regeneration of PNGs and manifest
Re-laid-out bedroom.yaml at 480x270 and manifest cleanup
Deleting every placeholder SVG and the unused SceneView path
out_of_scope: Inventory icons, UI frame kit, lighting work
preserve: Go API contracts and contribution flow
Existing BootScene animation, transition and keyboard behaviour

technical_constraints: Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix and Zustand stay
Art is raster pixel art generated deterministically in-repo; no downloaded art
One native resolution 480x270, whole-number scaling, nearest neighbour
Shared palette of at most 48 colours
No object, position or asset id hardcoded in a scene class
Tests are unit tests with dependencies mocked
definition_of_done: All four requirements are done and verified
